3/G.goal: Explain the main application domains of augmented reality and classify AR systems into marker-based and markerless categories.
3/G.achieves: It gives the learner a foundation for understanding what AR applications are for and how they are technically distinguished, which supports later XR hardware/software analysis and system development.

3/O1.goal: Explain the main application domains of augmented reality and illustrate them with examples from consumer/customer experience and healthcare, emphasizing augmentation of real-world content rather than immersion.
3/O1.achieves: It helps the learner recognize where AR is used and what user tasks it supports, which prepares them to gather requirements and evaluate use cases for an XR system.

3/O2.goal: Classify AR systems into marker-based and markerless categories and identify the location-based, superimposition-based, projection-based, and outlining-based markerless techniques.
3/O2.achieves: It gives the learner a technical taxonomy for recognizing the sensing, tracking, and presentation methods behind AR applications, supporting later hardware, software, and design decisions.
